title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins deploy and govern MCP-based agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The briefing passes: the documented controls, automation, licensing and qualified blocking behaviour are supported. It correctly distinguishes current Learn documentation from the overdue roadmap target and unknown roadmap default. One small clarification should acknowledge Microsoft's differing descriptions of the external-publisher option.
